title: Accommodation
description: Extend your relaxation – comfortable and warm overnight stays available for our sauna guests.

whiteSauna.title: Wet Sauna
whiteSauna.description: Located in the sauna building, always warm – even during the coldest winter months.

blackSauna.title: Gray Sauna
blackSauna.description: Separate building with built-in kitchen. Quiet room with good insulation.

transport.title: Public Transport:
transport.description: By bus from Riga to the "Dzimtmisa" stop – we collect you there free of charge (choose it when booking). Or choose the transfer from Riga and back – €60 for up to 4 people, €120 for up to 8; for larger groups the price is agreed separately.
